title: Source-backed documentation tracking
summary: Compare source-locale Markdown and reusable examples with a project-owned public API contract, emit a non-blocking report and accept reviewed fingerprints through a stale-safe plan.
invariants: The feature is optional and does not change projects without documentation_tracking.
The source project owns the public contract; Docara owns matching, statuses, reporting, scaffold and acceptance.
Status, validation and build do not edit Markdown, examples or the documentation lock.
Acceptance is hash-bound to configuration, source contract, page, examples and the previous lock.
Translation freshness remains a separate capability.
Docara never invokes a network or model for documentation tracking.
